name: tmc-level-params
description: Level difficulty parameter generator for level designers: from a level range and Normal/Hard/ExHard counts, generate per-level totals, kinds, four-category split, targets, stacking, moving vehicles and duration from competitor mainline statistics.

interface.shortDescription: Generate per-level difficulty parameters for a batch of levels.
interface.longDescription: For level designers, not production. Input a level range and how many Normal, Hard and ExHard levels it holds. The generator places the difficulties, then draws each level's joint form, total count T, kind count U, building/prop/vehicle/character split, targets, stacking structure, moving vehicles and duration from real competitor levels near the same position, checks every level and the batch, and writes level-params.json/csv/xlsx. Items are placeholders (building 1, prop 3); level production binds them to a theme. A local web page draws difficulty curves against the competitor levels, re-draws single levels and exports xlsx. Standard library only; xlsx export needs xlsxwriter.
defaultPrompt: 生成 101–150 关的难度参数：Normal 35 关，Hard 10 关，ExHard 5 关。
打开难度曲线网页，看这一批和竞品同编号关卡的对比。
复查这份 level-params.json 是否还通过全部检查。
